title: Colorado Heat Pump Rebates Just Changed (Summer 2026 Update)
summary: A Denver installer podcast updates Colorado heat pump incentives in mid-2026: HEAR funds exhausted in the metro zone, Xcel rebates, stacking, financing and the reduced state tax credit.

assertions.quote: as of April 28th, the zone one funds are fully allocated. This went so fast

verdicts.note: HEAR allocations are capped per state and several programs, including Colorado, reported funds committed within months of launch.

assertions.quote: On our end, it's hours hours of work and paperwork and calculations and everything, photos, geotag photos

verdicts.note: Program descriptions and contractor reports show multi-step applications and approval or payment queues of weeks.

Canadian heat pump programs are complex and cumbersome: they vary by government, often require audits paid out of pocket, and pay out only after installation, and the administrative burden has been shown to hold households back (Canada only).

assertions.quote: the rebates are still $2,250 per ton at 5° performance for the heat pump.
They do stack on each other like you said

verdicts.note: Utility, state and local rebates are often combinable, subject to caps such as the HEAR per-household limit.
DOE highly recommends that states stack and braid HEEHR rebates with other programs and funding sources, but the statute bars combining them with another federal grant or rebate for the same project.

West Virginia designed its federal rebates to stack with the state weatherization program and local utility rebates (New Jersey plans the same with its Clean Energy Program); these are plans for a few states, not a general rule.

assertions.quote: if you do air sealing and insulation first, it's another $600 bonus if you do it before our heat pump HVAC system goes in
this is still in play for the full year 2026. It it got lowered 50% from from 2025. So now it's $1000 per home

verdicts.note: Colorado's state heat pump credit continued into 2026 at a reduced amount under the state schedule.

assertions.quote: the zero down things, the 0% Someone's paying for that and it's usually rolled into the homeowners cost

verdicts.note: Dealer-fee financing is commonly priced into the installed cost, though not every promotional offer raises the price.

assertions.quote: They can be one of the more expensive replacements for furnaces and boilers and stuff that you'll have in your lifetime
